style: anime storyboard, clean confident lineart, restrained flat colors, soft cel shading, consistent character designs, consistent palette, very aesthetic, masterpiece
global_prompt: 2girls, same two female swordswomen repeated across four panels, stone shrine landing at dusk, broad level upper landing on right and exactly two shallow steps descending toward left, red torii at far back right, stone lantern at back left. Camera always on east side of action, red-kimono defender A initially screen right on landing, navy attacker B screen left below. A keeps her sword fully inside its black sheath throughout, only B has a visible naked silver blade, no sword clash, no injury, no blood. Maintain the same shrine geometry and identity across every panel. This page continues directly from a missed horizontal slash. All characters are now on the upper flat landing; no one goes down the steps.

A.appearance: girl, long black hair tied back, red kimono, dark hakama, holding a black fully sheathed katana at her left hip

B.appearance: girl, short silver hair, navy blue sailor uniform, dark skirt, holding one drawn silver katana in both hands

negative: lowres, bad anatomy, extra arms, extra fingers, missing hands, watermark, logo, speech bubble, text, duplicate objects
